name: Cartwright
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Cartwright and have them choose another player, put the Repaired reminder token on that player.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Cartwright and have them choose another player, put the Repaired reminder token on that player.
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself); They are safe from Outsiders and Minions until dusk.
flavor: At the site of a broken cart, everyone’s an expert.
